title: Object Usage
description: How often every object is used inside the solution — fields, scripts, layouts, custom functions, value lists, base tables, table occurrences, relationships, external data sources and privilege sets. One list across all types, sorted by usage (unused and rarely used first), with a type filter; unused, rarely and heavily used objects and menu entry points as filters. A row shows who uses the object. The same numbers as the search column "Usage (internal)" and the Analysis Test Unused Code.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter — derived from the app-level filter.

params.name: type
params.description: Object types, comma-separated (Select, multiple); empty = all types.

params.name: rare_max
params.description: Threshold for 'rarely used': a used object with at most this many using objects (default 2).

params.name: class
params.description: Usage class filter of the list (KPI tile): used, rare, heavy, entry_point, unused; empty = all. Sticky, so it combines with ddr and type; the 'All objects' tile resets class and ddr.

params.name: ddr
params.description: List filter by DDR info (KPI tile): 'without' = only objects of files exported without DDR info; empty = all.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term of the object list. Sticky: it survives KPI tile clicks and row clicks; cleared in the search field.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort column of the object list (server sort). Sticky, like q.

params.name: dir
params.description: Sort direction of the object list (asc/desc). Sticky, like q.

params.name: obj_uuid
params.description: Selected object (UUID) for the detail cards.
